title: Restore persistent operable Dev profile and prove isolated authenticated product writes

rootCause.summary: The hosted Dev frontend deployment manifest was previously pinned to read-only because .github/workflows/nonprod-deploy.yml defaults the workflow_dispatch input frontend_profile to read-only (withVITE_BFF_REAL_WRITES=false) unless frontend_profile=operator-live is explicitly passed to the exact-pair release controller, and scripts/auto_deploy_dev_pair.py preserves the currently accepted hosted profile from https://app.dev.mvl-cap.tw/deployment.json (defaulting to read-only only when no valid hosted profile is readable).

workflowDefault.operatorLiveSetting: VITE_BFF_REAL_WRITES=true with VITE_BFF_MODE=live, VITE_BFF_FALLBACK=strict, VITE_BFF_ALLOW_DEV_STUB_WRITES=false, VITE_BFF_EMBEDDED_BEARER_TOKEN=false

autoDeployPreservation.behavior: Reads https://app.dev.mvl-cap.tw/deployment.json and preserves operator-live across subsequent hourly/automatic dev-pair deployments once an accepted operator-live release is published; falls back to read-only only if the manifest is unreachable or invalid.

defectsDiscoveredAndFollowUpTasks.symptomOn0cd59ab286b7: UI constraint edit (POST /bff/v1/commands with action create_constraint on evp-c0ce26091e8b443495bfa61e3dac34ff) returned 422 VALIDATION_FAILED: Unknown evolution program action: createconstraint because BFF stripped underscores from action and did not forward commandPayload.action to the evolution owner service.

defectsDiscoveredAndFollowUpTasks.symptomOna8206a2d333f: Evolution Journal tab hid counts and controls when secondary reads failed even though primary /bff/management/evolution-journal succeeded.

defectsDiscoveredAndFollowUpTasks.symptomOn0cd59ab286b7: /bff/management/evidence intermittently exceeded the 1.2s owner read timeout on hosted Dev, causing degraded banner on /management/evidence.
